title: Checkout latency and elevated 5xx after release
summary: Checkout p95 latency rose from 420 ms to 4.8 s and HTTP 5xx reached 18% after the 14:02 release.

evidence.content: checkout-api version 2026.07.22-rc3 rollout started at 10% canary.
p95 latency increased to 4.8 seconds; HTTP 503 rate reached 18%.
database connection pool timeout after 2000ms; active=50 idle=0 waiting=137.
Postgres CPU is 61%; max connections unchanged; new pricing query p99 is 3.9 seconds.
pricing lookup accounts for 87% of checkout request duration in failing traces.
